Samira C.: quick pulse — sharing p95/p99 by route + model and streaming vs non-streaming. want any red flags / blockers before i share with account?
Jorge R.: paste of the last 24h numbers:```route:
  /chat (model-rl-13b-n): streaming p95=120ms p99=330ms; sync p95=240ms p99=610ms
  /complete (model-rl-13b-q4): streaming p95=95ms p99=260ms; sync p95=180ms p99=480ms
  /embed (embed-small): p95/p99 similar streaming/sync ~ 60/140ms (low variance)```
Priya N.: thanks — noticed spend for this account jumped ~28% week-over-week. any correlation with increased sync traffic?
Ava L.: error-rate callout: /complete for model-rl-13b-n saw errors rise from 0.06% -> 0.32% in last 8h (mostly timeouts). p99 spike aligns with those timeouts.
Tam (eng): i dug into logs — there were 3 autoscale evictions in us-west1 around 01:12/02:03/03:41 UTC, autoscaler reprovisioning caused queueing. can mitigate by temporary routing to model-rl-13b-q4 (quantized) for non-critical traffic.
InfraBot: [auto] autoscaler: scale_down_event id=as-882 at 2026-02-20T01:12:10Z; recovery complete 60s later.
Jorge R.: if we route less-latency-sensitive sync calls to q4 variant, we expect p95 sync to drop ~20-30% and p99 sync to tighten. that should also reduce spend due to fewer retries.
Samira C.: proposal: 1) enable canary routing to q4 for sync on /complete (10% -> 50% over 6h) 2) add shorter timeout for sync retry path 3) CS to flag customer that were doing a temporary routing change to reduce risk.
Priya N.: customer FYI: ill call them today, mention spend surge + mitigation plan. ask if any critical workflows require the n-variant for sync (we need explicit opt-out).
Tam (eng): i'll run the canary this afternoon and monitor p95/p99 and error-rate. will post back with dashboard snapshots.
Samira C.: action items captured: Samira/ Priya -> customer comms; Tam -> canary & monitor; Jorge -> adjust routing policy & rollback criteria; check-in Friday AM. :white_check_mark:
